title: The Oh My Posh theme definition

gradient.title: Gradient color
gradient.description: A linear-gradient(...) value that blends two or more comma-separated color stops across the segment.

shade.title: Shade color
shade.description: A darken(color, percent) or lighten(color, percent) value that shifts a single color toward black or white.

filler.title: Filler

aliases.title: Aliases

foreground_templates.description: A list of templates evaluated in order; the first one that resolves to a non-empty string sets the foreground color.

background_templates.description: A list of templates evaluated in order; the first one that resolves to a non-empty string sets the background color.

block.description: A horizontal section of the prompt that groups one or more segments together on a single line.

overflow.title: Block overflow
overflow.description: How to handle this block when it no longer fits the terminal width: break moves it to a new line, hide removes it.

filler.description: The character(s) repeated to fill the gap between this left-aligned and a right-aligned block.

type.title: Block type
type.description: Whether this block renders as the main prompt or the right-aligned prompt (rprompt).

alignment.title: Block alignment
alignment.description: Whether the block is aligned to the left or right edge of the terminal.

newline.title: Newline
newline.description: Start the block on a new line before rendering its segments.

filler.description: The character(s) repeated to fill the gap between a left-aligned and right-aligned block.

overflow.title: Overflow
overflow.description: How to handle this block when it no longer fits the terminal width: break moves it to a new line, hide removes it.

leading_diamond.description: The character used to start the first segment of the block when you want it to always begin with a diamond shape.

trailing_diamond.title: Trailing diamond
trailing_diamond.description: The character used to end the last segment of the block when you want it to always finish with a diamond shape.

segments.title: Segments list, prompt elements to display based on context

force.description: Always render the block, even when every one of its segments is empty.

restart_cycle.description: Restart the shared color cycle from its first color at the start of this block instead of continuing where the previous block left off.

segment.title: Segment
segment.description: A single element of the prompt, such as the current path, git status, or a language version.

type.description: The segment type, which determines what information is displayed and which options are available.

style.title: Segment Style
style.description: How the segment is rendered relative to its neighbors: powerline, plain, diamond, or accordion.

background_templates.description: A list of templates evaluated in order; the first one that resolves to a non-empty string sets the background color.

min_width.description: Hide the segment while the terminal width stays below this value. Set to 0 to disable.

interactive.description: Stop escaping the segment's text so Bash/Zsh interactive prompt escape sequences inside it are interpreted rather than shown literally.

exclude_folders.description: Never render the segment while the current path is inside one of these folders.

cache.description: Controls how long the segment's rendered output is reused before it's refreshed again, useful when the segment is slow to compute.

strategy.description: Choose how cache entries are matched, such as by folder, shell session, or device.

fallback_template.description: A template rendered instead of hiding the segment when it has no data to show. Since the segment isn't fully loaded at that point, stick to static text and global template variables here. Leave empty to hide the segment as usual.

then.title: Orthodox Calendar Segment
then.description: Displays the Orthodox fasting level and feast information for the current day. Data comes from the orthocal.info API, which follows OCA rubrics. This is the same data source used by meatandright.com.

units.title: units
units.description: Units of measurement. Available values are standard (kelvin), metric (celsius), and imperial (fahrenheit). Default is standard.

mapped_locations_enabled.title: Enable the Mapped Locations feature
mapped_locations_enabled.description: Replace known locations in the path with the replacements before applying the style.

mapped_locations_regex_expand.title: Expand regex capture groups in Mapped Locations
mapped_locations_regex_expand.description: When a mapped_locations key uses the re: prefix, expand $1, ${name}, etc. in the replacement value using the full regex match instead of only substituting the first capture group.

max_depth.title: Maximum Depth
max_depth.description: Maximum path depth to display without shortening.

max_width.title: Maximum Width
max_width.description: Maximum path width to display for powerlevel style.

mixed_threshold.title: Mixed threshold
mixed_threshold.description: The maximum length of a path segment that will be displayed when using mixed style.

hide_root_location.title: Hide the root location
hide_root_location.description: Hides the root location, when using agnoster_short style, if it doesn't fit in the last max_depth folders.

cycle.title: Color overrides to use to cycle through and color the path per folder

cycle_folder_separator.title: Cycle the folder_separator_icon

left_format.description: Will default to whatever edge_format is set to.

right_format.title: The format to use on the last folder of the path

gitdir_format.title: The format to use on a git root directory

display_cygpath.title: Display the Cygwin (Linux) style path

display_root.title: Display the root directory (/) on Unix systems

dir_length.title: Directory Length
dir_length.description: The length of the directory name to display in fish style.

full_length_dirs.title: Full Length Dirs
full_length_dirs.description: Indicates how many full length directory names should be displayed in fish style.

path.description: The path to the registry key (case insensitive, must use backslashes).  Ending with \ will retrieve "(Default)" key in that path.

fallback.title: Fallback value
fallback.description: Value to display if registry value cannot be retrieved.

zigicon.title: Zig Icon
zigicon.description: Icon to display before the version.

final_space.title: Final Space
final_space.description: Add a trailing space to the end of the prompt.

enable_cursor_positioning.title: Enable Cursor Positioning
enable_cursor_positioning.description: Fetch the cursor position so the prompt can avoid leaving a leading blank line at the top of the terminal.

shell_integration.title: FTCS command marks for shell integration
shell_integration.description: Wrap the prompt and command output in FTCS (Final Term Control Sequences) markers so supported terminals can identify command boundaries, enabling features like command status in the scrollbar and jump-to-previous-command.

pwd.title: Enable OSC99/7/51
pwd.description: Report the current working directory to the terminal using OSC 99, 7, or 51 sequences.

upgrade.title: Enable Upgrade Notice
upgrade.description: Enable the upgrade notice or automatic updates for Oh My Posh.

source.description: Where to check for and download new releases from. "cdn" uses the Oh My Posh CDN; "github" queries the GitHub releases API directly.

auto.description: Automatically download and install new releases in the background instead of only notifying that one is available.

notice.description: Show a one-time notice in the prompt when a new release is available.

patch_pwsh_bleed.title: Patch PowerShell Color Bleed
patch_pwsh_bleed.description: Work around a PowerShell color-bleed issue that can leave stray background colors at the end of the buffer.

console_title_template.title: Console Title Template
console_title_template.description: Template used to render the terminal's window title.

streaming.title: Streaming Mode
streaming.description: Enable streaming mode with a timeout in milliseconds for segments that are still resolving.

blocks.title: Block array
blocks.description: A list of blocks that define the prompt layout and the segments each block renders.

tooltips.title: Tooltip list, prompt elements to display based on context
tooltips.description: A list of tooltip segments that appear when you type matching commands.

tips.title: The commands for which you want the segment to show

transient_prompt.title: Transient Prompt Setting
transient_prompt.description: Configure the prompt that replaces the primary prompt after a command is executed.

newline.title: Newline
newline.description: Add a newline before the prompt.

right_template.title: Right Template
right_template.description: The right-aligned template to render next to the transient prompt, supported in zsh and PowerShell only.

valid_line.title: Valid Line Setting (for PowerShell only)
valid_line.description: Render a custom prompt when the current PowerShell input line is valid.

error_line.title: Error Line Setting (for PowerShell only)
error_line.description: Render a custom prompt when the current PowerShell input line contains an error.

secondary_prompt.title: Secondary Prompt Setting
secondary_prompt.description: Configure the prompt shown for multi-line commands.

multiline_keepprompt.title: Multiline Keep Prompt
multiline_keepprompt.description: Treat multi-line commands as a single block to support transient prompts correctly.

debug_prompt.title: Debug Prompt Setting (for PowerShell only)
debug_prompt.description: Configure the prompt shown while debugging a PowerShell script.

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: A map of named colors that can be reused throughout the theme.

palettes.title: Palettes
palettes.description: A set of alternate palettes that can be selected dynamically at runtime.

template.title: Prompt Template
template.description: A template that resolves to the key of the palette (in "list") to activate; leave empty or unresolved to use the default palette.

list.title: List of palettes
list.description: A map of palette name to palette definition; each named palette can be activated at runtime via the "template" above.

cycle.title: List of settings to cycle through segment by segment
cycle.description: A list of foreground and background colors to rotate through as segments render.

iterm_features.title: The iTerm2 features to enable
iterm_features.description: iTerm2-specific shell integration features to enable. "prompt_mark" marks the prompt line so iTerm2 can jump between commands, "current_dir" reports the working directory for the title bar and new tabs/panes, and "remote_host" reports the hostname/username for badges and session restore.

terminal_features.title: Terminal features configuration
terminal_features.description: Map terminal features to the terminals that support them.

progress.title: Progress terminals
progress.description: Terminal programs supporting OSC 9;4 progress sequences, matched case-insensitively against $TERM_PROGRAM. Defaults to Windows Terminal.

var.title: Config variables to use in templates (can be any value)
var.description: Custom variables that can be referenced from templates.

maps.title: Custom text mappings
maps.description: Custom replacements for user, host, and shell names used in templates.

async.title: Async loading
async.description: Render segments as their data becomes available instead of waiting for every segment to finish, so the prompt appears faster while slow segments (e.g. network- or git-heavy ones) update in place once ready.

tooltips_action.title: Tooltips action
tooltips_action.description: Choose whether tooltips replace, extend, or prepend the current right prompt.

version.title: Version
version.description: The schema version for the configuration file.

extends.title: Extends
extends.description: Path to another configuration file to inherit from.
